reason: My NRO money has sat there for years and I keep telling myself I'll sort it on my next trip. It isn't launching until 2027 and I won't act on a waitlist, so a signup now is just a polite maybe.
objection: They're not even FINTRAC-registered yet, and I'd be handing a stranger a six-figure rupee transfer with paperwork like Form 145 and 146. About CAD $317 on ₹10 lakh is real money for something I could do in person with no urgency.
would_change_my_mind: FINTRAC registration done, a few real reviews from people who moved a similar amount, and a total fee under about CAD $200 on ₹10 lakh.
